Irritable Bowel Syndrome

Ailment ibs digestive gut-health inflammation bloating

Evidence: peer_reviewed

Summary

Functional gastrointestinal disorder characterized by abdominal pain, bloating, and altered bowel habits (diarrhea or constipation).

Symptoms

  • abdominal pain
  • bloating
  • diarrhea
  • constipation
  • mucus in stool
  • fatigue

Remedies for This Condition

  • Probiotics
    Beneficial live microorganisms that support gut flora balance, immune function, and digestive health.
  • Peppermint Oil
    Cooling essential oil used for digestive complaints, headaches, and respiratory congestion.
  • Peppermint (Mentha Piperita)
    Cooling mint herb with antispasmodic properties; relieves digestive discomfort, IBS symptoms, and nausea.

Affected Body Systems

  • digestive
  • immune
  • nervous

Severity Levels

  • moderate
  • severe

Related Conditions

  • Arthritis
    Inflammatory joint disease; managed with dietary and herbal interventions.
  • Candida Overgrowth
    Overgrowth of Candida albicans yeast in the gut or other body systems.
  • Parasitic Infections
    Intestinal parasitic infections causing digestive distress and nutrient malabsorption.
  • Digestive Discomfort
    General digestive discomfort including bloating, gas, and indigestion.
  • Gallbladder Disease
    Impaired gallbladder function including gallstones and bile duct obstruction.
  • Gut Dysbiosis
    Imbalance of beneficial gut bacteria leading to digestive issues and compromised immunity.
  • Acid Reflux / GERD
    Gastroesophageal reflux disease causing heartburn and acid regurgitation.
